source: Report-only single-flow capture of the already-accepted assembled SSE leg TestCF003AssembledSSELookupLifecycle (@ 63b82d0 + 2340195 + f904b42, race green) under FU-02 Option A; no corpusctl recorder behavior change, no v1 oracle. One subscriber only: a single SSE connection on the owned isolated transactions-lookup-lifecycle fixture (app 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003) reproduces the SSE leg step for step — seed (title lookup-one), init, add-query, a lookup-eid update retargeting the seeded entity converging as refresh-ok at the exact trigger watermark, and an absent-id lookup update minting a fresh entity converging as refresh-ok at its exact trigger watermark. The seed and both lookup admin transacts run live; every GET/POST exchange and all 6 stream data frames replay exactly under the documented masking rule.
redaction: CF-002 discipline: volatile transport headers (Date, Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding) excluded; SSE heartbeat comment records (: ping keepalives, timing-dependent) excluded — only parsed data-payload objects are compared, key order insignificant. Masking rule (mechanical, enforced by the replay test): session-bearing string values are never checked in. The checked-in POST bodies and stream frames carry sentinel placeholders <lookup-transport-session>, <lookup-token>, <lookup-machine-id>, <lookup-protocol-session>, <lookup-attr-id-todos-id>, <lookup-attr-id-todos-title>, <lookup-fresh-eid> in exactly the positions the live server emits random values (transport handshake session-id/sse-token/machine-id, POST session_id/sse_token, protocol-init session-id, attr id fields, minted fresh entity id in the second refresh). The replay test substitutes the live values into the templates (POSTs) and masks the live frames back to the sentinels (stream) before whole-result reflect.DeepEqual; any checked-in real session value (any sess- substring) or missing sentinel fails the test before any byte is replayed. The refresh-ok watermarks (processed-tx-id 0 initial, 2 and 3) are deterministic across fresh isolated DBs (seed tx 1, proven byte-stable on two runs) and are asserted exactly equal to the live tx-ids as float64. Application payload keys (titles, seeded entity ID, op names, event IDs, app-id, forward-identities) are retained exactly and remain comparison-significant. No timestamps, DSNs, or database URLs appear in these bytes.
excluded: Excluded with reason: (1) the seed and both lookup admin transacts (POST /admin/transact) — their responses carry per-database transaction watermarks tied to database state and their requests carry the credential-bearing X-admin-token header, so exact byte check-in is inappropriate; all three run live with the accepted assembled-leg shape (200 with a positive tx-id asserted live, strictly advancing; each refresh processed-tx-id asserted exactly equal to the live trigger tx-id as float64). (2) Teardown-poll intermediate 200 empty envelopes — the count of 200s before the dead-reader teardown lands is timing-dependent; only the terminal 401 unknown sse session exchange is checked in and it is asserted live after a bounded poll, mirroring the accepted leg. (3) HTTP query convergence bodies — the todos query over POST /runtime/framework/query converges byte-exactly (baseline lookup-one, post-update lookup-two, two-entity lookup-two plus fresh in id order) and is asserted live whole-body with whole-result DeepEqual lengths-before-elements rather than checked in, since the query path is the convergence oracle, not the stream under capture; the minted fresh entity id is discovered live from the second refresh and never checked in. Heartbeat comments are excluded per the redaction rule above, not a behavior exclusion.
